For a limited time, when you add $5.10 to your CloudCone account, we’ll match a portion of it, giving you a total of $7.65 in cloud credits to use! You can request a refund at any time, as long as you haven't used the credits. How to collect your bonus:

Visit app.cloudcone.com/billing
Add exactly $5.10 to your account
Enjoy $7.65 in total credits

Don’t wait! This cloud credit bonus is only available for 24 hours. It’s open to both new and existing customers, so take advantage while you can!

虽然 CloudCone 今年的发生了数据全损事故，但是……便宜啊 所以我还是备份后充了……
